creature.name: Boggard Scout
creature.source: Pathfinder Game Night: Dawn of the Frogs (Deluxe Adventure)

mid.name: Swamp Passage
entries: A boggard scout ignores difficult terrain caused by swamp terrain features.

mid.name: Terrifying Croak
entries: The boggard scout unleashes a terrifying croak. Any non-boggard within 30 feet becomes frightened 1 unless they succeed at a DC 17 Will save. Those who critically succeed are temporarily immune for 1 minute.

mid.name: Tongue Grab
entries: If the boggard scout hits a creature with their tongue, that creature becomes grabbed by the boggard. Unlike with a normal Grab, the creature is not immobilized, but it can't move beyond the reach of the boggard's tongue. The DC to Escape is 18, or a creature can sever the tongue by hitting AC 13 and dealing at least 2 slashing damage. Though this doesn't deal any damage to the boggard, it prevents them from using their tongue Strike again until they regrow their tongue, which takes a week.

creature.name: Python
creature.source: Pathfinder Game Night: Dawn of the Frogs (Deluxe Adventure)

mid.name: Tighten Coils
mid.trigger: A creature grabbed or restrained by the python attempts to Escape
entries: Effect The DC of the Escape check is increased by 2.

mid.name: Constrict
entries: 1d8 bludgeoning, DC 17 Fortitude save halves the damage on a success (no damage on a critical success, double damage on a critical failure)

mid.name: Grab
entries: After the python bites a creature with its jaws, it can attempt an Athletics check against the target's Fortitude DC (Fortitude DC = a target's Fortitude save bonus + 10). If successful, the character is grabbed, and the python cannot bite anyone again until it wraps up the creature in its coils. The DC to Escape is 16.

mid.name: Wrap in Coils
entries: The python moves the creature into its coils, freeing its jaws to make attacks, then uses Constrict against the creature. The python's coils can hold one creature.

entries: The hunting spider automatically notices the creature and Strides, Climbs, or Descends on a Web before it rolls initiative

mid.name: Descend on a Web
entries: The hunting spider moves straight down up to 40 feet, suspended by a web line. It can hang from the web or drop off. The distance it Descends on a Web doesn't count for falling damage. entries: Saving Throw DC 16 Fortitude; Maximum Duration 6 rounds; Stage 1 1d4 poison damage and off-guard (1 round); Stage 2 1d6 poison damage, clumsy 1, and off-guard (1 round); Stage 3 1d6 poison damage, clumsy 2, and offguard (1 round)

mid.name: Web Trap
entries: A creature hit by the hunting spider's web Strike is immobilized and stuck to the nearest surface until it Escapes (DC 17).

creature.name: Zungur
creature.source: Pathfinder Game Night: Dawn of the Frogs (Deluxe Adventure)

mid.name: Focusing Drone
mid.trigger: Zungur attempts a Will saving throw
entries: Zungur reflexively groans in a series of low, rhythmic croaking sounds to help her focus her mind on her faith in the frog goddess Gogunta. She rolls a Performance check. She can use the higher result between her Performance check and her Will saving throw to resolve the effects against the attack that triggered her Will saving throw.

mid.name: Destructive Croak
entries: Zungur utters a powerful croak that deals 4d6 sonic damage to any non-boggard within a 15-foot emanation. Any creature with the frightened condition takes additional sonic damage equal to twice the value of its frightened condition. Zungur can't use Destructive Croak again for 1d4 rounds.

mid.name: Swamp Passage
entries: Zungur ignores difficult terrain caused by swamp terrain features.

mid.name: Terrifying Croak
entries: Zungur unleashes a terrifying croak. Any non-boggard within 30 feet becomes frightened 1 unless they succeed at a DC 19 Will save. Those who critically succeed are temporarily immune for 1 minute.

mid.name: Tongue Grab
entries: If Zungur hits a creature with their tongue, that creature becomes grabbed by the boggard. Unlike with a normal Grab, the creature is not immobilized, but it can't move beyond the reach of Zungur's tongue. The DC to Escape is 18, or a creature can sever the tongue by hitting AC 15 and dealing at least 4 slashing damage. Though this doesn't deal any damage Zungur, it prevents them from using their tongue Strike again until they regrow their tongue, which takes a week.
